subject: scripts/service-smoke.mjs — three stale predicates in the ok-chain

rootCause.statement: The markers moved; the predicates did not follow. Not a fake gate, and not a deleted attribute.
rootCause.detail: INIT-001 made / the cockpit landing page (lands on My work). The owner-quality landing view, and with it data-owner-quality-first-viewport="product-led", moved to /cockpit. app.tsx rewrites modulePath / to /my-work and returns MyWorkView, so the app.tsx:566 branch is unreachable from / and reachable from /cockpit.
rootCause.decisiveEvidence: Commit 8e76ef5 (STORY-001/002/005/006/007) already re-pointed apps/api/test/service-smoke.test.mjs — / now asserts data-cockpit-view="my-work" and product-led moved to the else branch — but missed this second copy of the same predicate in scripts/service-smoke.mjs. One predicate existing in two places, updated in one.

diagnosisMethod.why: The ok value is one long && chain, so the first false predicate hides every later one. Evaluating each predicate independently was required to find all of them rather than fixing one and hitting the next.

staleFindings.verdict: predicate never checked what its name claimed
staleFindings.detail: data-product-shell-route is the DS Navigation item id — it asserts the sidebar offers a route by that name, not that this response is that route. INIT-001 replaced the nav with eleven module ids, so no item is called cockpit.

repairChoice.rejected: Translating the nav id to a current module id, which would preserve a predicate that still does not check what it is named.
repairChoice.rejectedAlso: Making the assertion pass. That is removing the gate, not repairing it.
repairChoice.applied: Assert the content each route actually renders, and give / the markers it now carries.

mutationProof.method: For each replacement predicate, delete every occurrence of the marker it names from the real response and confirm the predicate flips to false. A predicate that cannot fail is not a gate.

receiptChange.productLedMarkerPresent: kept its key, changed its subject to /cockpit
receiptChange.productLedMarkerRoute: added, so a reader comparing this receipt to an older one can see the subject moved rather than regressed

boundary.notFixedHere: aos:frontend-shell-proof is red on strictRegisteredSurfaceBuiltHits. It had never been reached because service:smoke precedes it in pnpm verify and failed first.
boundary.whyNotFolded: That red is a real architectural violation (140 local tcrn-aos-* visible classes across twelve cockpit source files, from 1a2d59e) plus one gate-predicate defect (a chain minutes body quoting a demo class name, read as a demo leak). Neither is the stale-predicate class this incident covers, and the first needs a direction ruling.
